# Portfolio Vision

> A free web app that breaks an ETF portfolio down into the individual companies
> you actually own. Enter your positions and it recursively unwraps every fund —
> including ETFs held inside other ETFs — merges overlapping positions, and shows
> your true exposure by company, sector, and country.

Portfolio Vision exists because brokerages show you funds, not ownership. If you
hold VFV, XEQT, and some AAPL, your brokerage shows three rows — but VFV holds
500 companies, XEQT holds four other ETFs which together hold thousands, and
AAPL already sits inside both. Portfolio Vision resolves that into one accurate
picture.

## How it works

1. **Add your positions.** Each ETF or stock you own, by dollar amount or share
   count, in USD or CAD. A Wealthsimple CSV can be imported instead of typing.
2. **Decomposition runs.** Every ETF is unpacked into its underlying holdings,
   recursively up to five levels deep, weighted by what you actually hold.
   This runs entirely client-side against a bundled dataset.
3. **See what you really hold.** One combined view of every company, sector,
   and country across the whole portfolio, with a per-holding breakdown of
   which funds the money comes from.

## Pages

- [Portfolio builder and results](https://portfoliovision.online/): the whole app
- [Privacy Policy](https://portfoliovision.online/privacy): what is stored, what is never collected, how to delete an account
- [Terms of Service](https://portfoliovision.online/terms): usage terms and accuracy limits

## Notable behaviour

- **Weights are estimates.** ETF holdings data is point-in-time and funds
  rebalance continuously. Weightings may be off by roughly a percent.
- **"Untracked" is surfaced, not hidden.** Holdings weights rarely sum to 100%.
  The remainder is reported explicitly rather than normalized away, so the
  portfolio total stays accurate.
- **Covered-call and leveraged ETFs are excluded.** They do not reflect true
  ownership of the underlying stocks.
- **Commodities are entered by name** — "Gold" rather than GLD, "Silver" rather
  than SLV.
- **Unrecognized tickers still work.** They are marked in amber and tracked
  as-is rather than being rejected.

## Coverage and limits

ETF holdings data is manually maintained and current as of May 2026. Live prices
come from Yahoo Finance via a server-side proxy, covering TSX, TSX-V, Cboe Canada,
CSE, and US exchanges, plus FX and crypto. FX conversion for currencies other than
USD/CAD derives the other side via the USD/CAD rate.

Nothing on the site is financial advice.
